input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability limitation in the Agreement (p0077, buried at the end of the Indemnity section) is one-sided: it caps TrueLink's liability at 12 months' hosting and support compensation, while Client's liability — including its broad indemnity under Section 12a — remains entirely uncapped. That is expressly walk-away territory under this rule ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped"), so it fails the fallback, which requires a mutual 12-month cap. The clause is also narrower than it appears in one respect (it only covers matters under Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11) and carves out only TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct; there is no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere in the document (search for "consequential" returns nothing) and no carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security or indemnification. The redline makes the cap mutual and agreement-wide, sets the basis at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds the mutual consequential-damages exclusion and the standard uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms Client's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual and agreement-wide, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and applied it to the whole Agreement — as drafted only TrueLink's liability is capped (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11), leaving Client exposed without limit, which we cannot accept. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap and Client's payment obligations unaffected.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
